breakpoint.$description: Viewport breakpoints (ADR-079, icvoss/django-brickwork#220). Emitted as literal values on :root in tokens.css AND as a plain @theme block (never @theme inline) in tailwind-theme.css, from this single source, because media queries cannot resolve var(): the mechanism that makes the colour/type/radius/elevation @theme inline projection live-adjustable is structurally unavailable to viewport queries. Overriding these tokens in a consumer's own brand CSS adjusts that consumer's OWN Tailwind sm:/md:/lg:/xl: utilities; it does not move brickwork's own shipped brickwork.css breakpoints, which are compiled in and change only on a package rebuild (the honest limit, ADR-079 section 7). Values match Tailwind's own default breakpoint scale and stay in rem (mixed units break Tailwind's generated-rule ordering).

md.$description: The shell's sidebar-to-drawer collapse point (SHL-017) and _data_table's responsive="stack" threshold (TBL-013); both reuse this one value so the two surfaces change together.

xl.$description: Reserved: named by SHL-014 and emitted for completeness; no internal brickwork call site references it yet.
